steps.name: Pre-session — Welcome slide (put this up before people arrive)
steps.say: Nothing to say yet — this is what people see as they trickle in and join. Run this step, then just wait; move on to the icebreaker once most of the room is in.

steps.name: 0:00 — Icebreaker: one word
steps.say: Add one word to the shared board: what's your current relationship with AI in your teaching, right now, honestly?

steps.name: 0:05 — Baseline gut-check
steps.say: Set your status: doing ok = I feel clear about what's allowed right now, confused = somewhat unsure, stuck = pretty lost, away = haven't thought about it yet. No wrong answer — we compare this again at the end.

steps.name: 0:10 — Order the five AI usage levels
steps.say: Drag these five statements into order, from most restrictive (no AI at all) to most open (AI as a creative partner).

steps.name: 0:20 — Match the concern to the discipline
steps.say: Different fields worry about different things when it comes to AI. Drag each concern into the discipline most likely to raise it — a couple of pieces are decoys.

steps.name: 0:30 — Facts worth remembering
steps.say: Quick reinforcement round — drag the right piece into each blank. There are a couple of decoys here too.

steps.name: 0:40 — Redesign in groups: make the groups
steps.say: Find your group on this tab — same base assignment for everyone, shown on the next screen.

steps.name: 0:40 (b) — Show the assignment
steps.say: Here's the assignment everyone's redesigning — it'll stay up on the Slide tab if you need to check it again.

steps.name: 0:41 — Redesign in groups: start the timer, send to whiteboard
steps.say: In your group, rewrite the instructions twice: once as a Level 1 version (AI only for planning), once as a Level 3 version (AI used extensively, but directed and justified). Post your Level 3 version as a sticky note.

steps.name: 0:48 — Reset the timer after debrief
steps.say: Let's hear two or three Level 3 notes out loud before we move on.

steps.name: 0:50 — Closing self-check
steps.say: Rate yourself on these right now — no one else sees your name attached to your answer, just the shape of the room.

steps.name: 0:57 — Re-check the baseline
steps.say: Same check as the start. Let's see if that moved.

steps.name: 0:58 — Open Q&A
steps.say: Anonymous question queue is open — ask anything, including things you didn't want to say out loud. I'll keep it open after we leave the room.
